The Router handled this well by flagging it as a deviation rather than a generation error. All other checkpoints (Head, Eyes, Ears, Coat, Body, Legs, Gait) are correctly marked as present and testable. The Router was not too lenient; in fact, it was appropriately strict on the tail definition.
